Primary Questions: What supply is actually usable by need date?
Key Evidence: Available held late and uncertain quantities; demand and forecast context
Material Exceptions: Late receipts quality holds stale ETAs
Accountable Action: Adjust forecast allocation or inventory plan

Primary Questions: What commitment is authorized and what requires supplier action?
Key Evidence: Open PO approved changes shipment quantities cancellations
Accountable Action: Confirm commitment and coordinate supplier correction

Primary Questions: Where is the shipment and is the timing trustworthy?
Key Evidence: Carrier events transportation milestones ETA freshness
Material Exceptions: Missed milestone stale ETA missing carrier event
Accountable Action: Refresh milestone and communicate timing risk

Primary Questions: What is physically onsite and what can be made available?
Key Evidence: Appointment delivery receipt putaway and hold status

Primary Questions: What can be matched to commitment receipt acceptance and invoice?
Key Evidence: Ordered received accepted invoiced disputed and returned quantities
Material Exceptions: Invoice mismatch duplicate billing unaccepted quantity

Primary Questions: Which exceptions materially affect value timing or service?
Key Evidence: Exception value age root cause owner and deadline
Material Exceptions: High-value aged or deadline-critical unresolved items

Primary Questions: Shows role-specific use of one source-linked ledger
